## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] I included deterministic positive and negative coverage where behavior changed.
- [ ] I declared all permissions and kept V1 runtime dependencies empty.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private data, customer data, and protected implementation material.
- [ ] I have the right to submit every included artifact under Apache-2.0.
- [ ] I understand that validation or merge grants no execution, admission, learning, memory, or production authority.
- [ ] My commits include a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off (`git commit -s`).

## Reviewer notes

The author may verify mechanics but may not issue the independent review of
their own contribution.
